content: Spectracef® is contraindicated in patients who have a known allergy to cephalosporin-class antibiotics or any of its components. This means that individuals with a documented hypersensitivity to cephalosporins should not be prescribed this medication. Spectracef® is also contraindicated in patients with carnitine deficiency or those with inborn errors of metabolism that can lead to clinically significant carnitine deficiency. This is because the use of Spectracef® promotes renal excretion of carnitine, which can exacerbate or cause a deficiency in these patients. (Refer to the Precautions section for more details.) Additionally, Spectracef® tablets contain sodium caseinate, a milk protein. Therefore, patients with hypersensitivity to milk proteins (distinct from lactose intolerance) should not be given Spectracef®.
